{{recipe}} 

This '''anchovy herb salsa verde''' is different from Mexican salsa verde. It may be a Spanish recipe.

==Ingredients==
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] extra-virgin [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 9 cured [[Cookbook:Anchovy|anchovy]] fillets, drained, patted dry, and [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]]
* 6 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] finely-[[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]] fresh flat-leaf [[Cookbook:Parsley|curly parsley]]
* 3 tablespoons finely-chopped fresh [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]]
* 3 tablespoons finely-chopped fresh [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]]
* 3 tablespoons finely-chopped fresh [[Cookbook:Mint|mint]]
* ⅛ teaspoon freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]

==Procedure==
# In a small bowl, mix together all ingredients.
# Serve with chips or grilled meat.
